purpose: Define generic logical resource identity independently from storage path, URL, database row locator, network endpoint or runtime handle.

topics.name: Logical Resource Identity
topics.purpose: Define generic logical resource identity independently from storage path, URL, database row locator, network endpoint or runtime handle.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant logical resource has explicit identity.
semantics.binding_rule: One or more storage/network/address bindings may refer to the resource.
semantics.revision_rule: Resource revisions/content state are separately identifiable.
semantics.mobility_rule: Moving storage/address does not change logical identity by implication.
semantics.authority_rule: Knowing a resource identity/address does not grant access.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: row id assumed global identity without contract
